correctness.rationale: Exact support functions and epsilon-ellipse curvature formulas reconstruct the invariant set. Uniform summation of support points and Tonelli perimeter bound establish arclength charts; vertical-angle series estimates prove C2 always. The split q=a^2/b, r=a/b yields C3 iff qr<1 in q<1, or alpha=log(1/a)/log(r)<1/2 in q>1. At q=1 the logarithmic singularity rules out C3. Derivative estimates justify sufficient directions; even curvature and strict difference quotients justify failures at endpoints. The actual embedded verifier passed supplementary finite checks, which do not certify infinite cases.

value.rationale: Precise C2 regularity is a stated prerequisite in related persistence theory and precise attractor-boundary smoothness is explicitly open in the originating work. The theorem gives a natural complete classification by eigenvalue ratios, two sharp exceptional thresholds and reentrant C3 smoothness, plus a separate exact flat-curvature boundary. The new inequalities have geometric and dynamical motivation, rather than arbitrary parameter selection.
